full_prompt_en: A square cinematic architectural image shows a solitary person standing inside a monumental room where a sharp wedge of warm sunlight meets nearly complete darkness. The background on the left is a tall black interior recess, with only the faint outlines of successive rectangular doorframes revealing depth. On the right, a massive beige wall and fluted column rise beyond the top edge, their scale much larger than the small person below. A bright triangular patch of light begins high on the column and widens as it descends toward a doorway near the center. That opening has layered rectangular trim and a darker room visible beyond it, while the lit wall glows in cream and warm ochre. The figure stands just to the right of the central threshold, seen from behind as a nearly black upright silhouette. A dark jacket and trousers are suggested by the body shape, but facial detail is absent at this distance. The floor is smooth and dark, catching a faint vertical reflection beneath the figure and a broad strip of gold where the light crosses from the right. Long narrow shadows stretch over that illuminated strip toward the lower center. Architectural moldings, the column base, and the door trim remain precise, while the unlit half of the room loses most surface detail. Strong late light enters from an unseen opening at the right, carving a clean diagonal across the wall and floor; there is little fill light in the left recess. The warm wall and black void create a stark value contrast without many colors or objects. The overall composition makes the human silhouette a scale marker between towering geometry and intense light, producing a solemn, suspenseful stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形电影感建筑图像呈现一位孤身人物站在宏大的房间里，锋利的暖阳楔形区与近乎完全的黑暗相接。左侧背景是高大的黑色室内凹处，只有连续矩形门框的淡淡轮廓揭示纵深。右侧一面巨大米色墙和带竖槽的柱子向上超出画边，其尺度远大于下方小人物。一片明亮三角光区从柱子高处开始，向下拓宽至中央附近的门洞。那里有层叠矩形饰边，后方可见更暗的房间，受光墙壁则泛奶油与暖赭色。人物站在中央门槛稍右，背对观者，成为近黑的直立剪影。从身体形状可辨深色外套和长裤，但距离使面部细节完全不可见。地面平滑而深暗，在人物脚下接住淡淡竖向反光，右侧来光越过地面形成宽金色条带。几道狭长影子在亮带上延向下方中央。建筑饰线、柱脚和门边线保持精确，未受光的半间房几乎失去表面细节。强烈的偏晚光从右侧画外开口进入，在墙与地上切出清楚斜线；左侧凹处几乎没有补光。暖墙与黑色空洞形成鲜明明暗反差，不依赖繁多色彩或物件。整体构图让人体剪影成为高耸几何与强光之间的尺度标记，营造庄严而悬疑的静止感。
style_prompt_en: The image is built from monumental simple planes, deep near-black negative space, and one sharply bounded warm light field. Rectilinear layers create depth even when most surface detail disappears in shadow. Golden cream and muted umber occupy the lit region, while charcoal absorbs the opposite side. A hard directional beam cuts a diagonal across vertical architecture and leaves long narrow floor shadows; faint reflection adds weight below. Small silhouettes can establish scale without crowding the vast forms. The overall treatment is austere, cinematic, and suspenseful, with geometry and value contrast carrying the drama.
style_prompt_zh: 图像由宏大的简洁平面、深近黑负空间和一片边界锋利的暖光区域构成。层叠的直角结构在阴影吞没多数表面细节时仍创造纵深。金奶油色与低饱和深褐占据受光区，炭黑吸收另一侧。硬质定向光束在竖向建筑上切出斜线，并在地面留下狭长影子；淡反光在下方增加重量。小小剪影可建立尺度，而不挤占巨大形体。整体处理严峻、电影感强且悬疑，以几何和明暗反差承担戏剧性。
theme_en: A solitary figure stands where warm sunlight enters a monumental room
theme_zh: 一位孤身人物站在暖阳进入宏大房间的交界处
name: Contrasted lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
